ragPlans.title: RAG system plans and pricing
ragPlans.subtitle: AI that answers with your company's documents and cites the source. Start with a 2-week pilot using your own documents.
ragPlans.taxNote: Prices in COP and USD, plus VAT if applicable. Under each price you see the COP total with VAT.

price.monthlyBySla: Based on the service level (SLA) we agree on

piloto.name: RAG Pilot
piloto.tagline: Validate the AI with your own documents before rolling it out.
features: One document origin (for example, the files you send us)
Accuracy report with 50 test questions: how many it answered correctly, with which source, and how many it said “not found”
piloto.note: If you sign up for a plan within the following 30 days, the full pilot fee is deducted from the implementation: the pilot adds no cost.
needs: Up to 100 documents from a single origin.
50 real questions from your team, each with the answer you expect.
Someone on your team to review the answers with us.

esencial.name: Essential
esencial.tagline: An assistant with your company's documents on your website.
features: One document origin: manual upload, or Google Drive or SharePoint through a connector built in your project
monthlyIncludes: AI for up to 3,000 questions per month
esencial.accessNote: The chat on your site answers anyone who visits the page where you place it, so use it with documents that can be public. If your documents are internal or confidential, tell us when you request a quote: access control (role-based permissions) is built in your project from the Professional plan.

profesional.name: Professional
profesional.tagline: Multiple document origins, web and WhatsApp, with role-based permissions and metrics built in your project.
features: Up to 3 document origins (for example, manual upload, Drive and SharePoint)
Web and WhatsApp (the WhatsApp channel is built in your project)
monthlyIncludes: AI for up to 15,000 questions per month

empresarial.name: Enterprise
empresarial.tagline: Runs on your own infrastructure, with company sign-in and auditing built in your project.
features: Deployment on your cloud or on your own servers (on-premise)
Sign-in with your company accounts (SSO, built in your project)

notes.title: Good to know
notes.tax: COP and USD prices exclude VAT. Under each price you see the COP total with Colombia's general 19% VAT; the proposal confirms whether your case carries it.
notes.extraQuestion: Each additional question over your plan's monthly cap costs {cop} / {usd}.
notes.questionsExample: How many questions do you need? An example: 30 people × 5 questions a day × 20 business days = 3,000 questions a month.
notes.whatsapp: Meta's WhatsApp messaging fees are billed separately, at cost.

ragPlans.ctaNote: The buttons take you to a short form. We reply within 24 business hours to schedule a 30-minute call. You don't pay anything yet.
